name: audio-adaptive

scripts.build: if [ -n "$CHUGGIE_PREBUILT_ROM" ] && [ -f "$npm_package_name.gba" ]; then echo "using the prebuilt $npm_package_name.gba"; else tish build src/main.tish --target gba -o "$npm_package_name.gba"; fi

description: Adaptive music made testable: deck_pause keeps the playhead and the intensity where stop-then-play loses both, and audio_duck attenuates the whole PSG under dialogue instead of scaling voices one at a time.
